changes.summary: With resource_filters in resource_type::id form, export metadata loading can fetch only the listed IDs (including during dependency resolution) instead of listing every resource of that type, when the type's exporter supports targeted ID lookup; regex and label filters still list the full type.
IDs in an ID filter that no longer exist are omitted from export metadata without failing the run, consistent with list-then-filter behavior.
Targeted ID metadata fetches run with up to ten concurrent requests, which can reduce export time for large ID-filtered runs when targeted lookup is supported.

related_export_changes.summary: Entities exported as Terraform data sources now serialize from a separate data-source state copy so generated data blocks reflect data source schema attributes instead of incorrectly reusing enumeration state that was overwritten in place.
